claims.claim: Reading speed increased with working memory span.
claims.quote: Reading speed rose with span, t(34) = 2.45, p = .01.

claims.claim: Span moderated the effect of text difficulty.
claims.quote: Span moderated text difficulty effects, F(1, 38) = 4.20, p = .047.

claims.claim: Strategy choice was associated with group membership.
claims.quote: Strategy choice differed by group, chi-square(2) = 7.81, p = .02.

claims.claim: The span task follows an established protocol.
claims.quote: We used the established span protocol [21].

claims.claim: Reading speed norms match earlier published norms.
Span and reading speed were positively correlated.
claims.quote: Span and speed were correlated, r(48) = .35, p = .013.
